provenance: Hand literals transcribed from DEGREE-TWO-TARGET.md; joint mark fixture from pure_bridge/VERIFY_SPEC.json line 5. Exact integer/Boolean reference data, frozen before checker implementation and before any candidate proof read.

interface.tree: Natural leaf label or two-child JSON list
interface.vertex: Boolean address, false=left, true=right; retain unsuppressed vertices
interface.local: unique labels each tree; B nonempty duplicate-free common labels; restriction agrees; v in support of B in t; undirected induced-support degree(v)=2
interface.conclusion: exists exhaustive unordered bipartition with nonempty disjoint blocks, union B; each restriction agrees; supports disjoint and nested in original in each tree; both t supports avoid v
interface.consumer: actual RMAF.agreement before and after replacement, length increases by exactly one
interface.failure: Any mismatched positive literal, surviving named mutation, or in-regime case without full conclusion halts the run. Out-of-regime degree-three/duplicate/empty failures are controls, not counterexamples.

pilot.full_binary_ordered_trees: all 1,2,3 unique leaves labelled 0..n-1, plus every 4-leaf shape with increasing left-right labels and their full mirror
pilot.local_pairs: every ordered pair within each n plus explicit unequal-outside-B fixture
pilot.selections: all subsets including invalid empty, then all support vertices; full bipartition existence
pilot.consumers: all set partitions for same-label pairs; every degree-two block and every full refinement
